scope: Overlapped-recovery compact 6T TIME_CONTROL post-layout timing protocol (default compact controller; recovery_overlap=false keeps V2.2.9); this manifest is a protocol, not a pass record

architecture.netlist: ov12: PRE after sense release; writes restore once their WL is off; read_fired_held latch feeds read_complete
architecture.sizing_lookup: sram_compiler/sizing/layout_sizing_lookup.json (= outputs/pl_large/overlap/lookup_c10.json); evidence macros were built from lookup_c8/c9/c10, whose netlists are identical for every class except the 512x256-covered sizes (c9: enable_off 30) and 64x256/128x256 (c10: 256x256 peripheral sizing)
architecture.layout: band placement for self-timed controllers; overlap cell spacing 130 nm (16 rows) / 80 nm (<=256 rows) / 30 nm; overlap minimum frame 24.5 um; frame-candidate fallback (FRAME_ATTEMPTS=4)

cases.accesses: seq/mixed/first_read: first four accesses; reads: eight accesses (two writes, six back-to-back reads alternating rows)
cases.indices: Row, column and data patterns are shown for 32x32; other sizes use row 0, the last row and the last two columns the same way (dev/large_postlayout/campaign.py)

sets.round1: SS seq, SS read stream, FF/FS 125 C seq, FF -40 C seq at the V2.2.9 table clock
sets.stalled: SS read stream at about occupancy + 0.1 ns (measures recovered -> admit); skipped when restore binds by > 0.5 ns
sets.confirmation_square_and_512x256: 5 corners x seq/mixed, FF/SF -40 C first reads, SS/FF -40 C read streams (14 cases)
sets.confirmation_other: SS seq, SS read stream, FF -40 C, FF 125 C and FS 125 C seq (5 cases), at the published clock

clock_policy.cycle_budget: max(longest SS 0.9 V 125 C read occupancy (access_admit -> recovered) + stalled recovered -> admit delay, restore-limited spacing = admission -> last far bitline and RBL at 0.96 VDD at the worst measured corner)
clock_policy.access_budget: Worst capture -> OUT with every selected latch settled at that spacing
clock_policy.margin: One 10 percent margin, each budget rounded up to 50 ps; the joint grid is made monotonic upward
clock_policy.recheck: After each confirmation both terms are recomputed from its SS/FS cases; a term above the budget raises it and the class is rerun

verification.physical: DRC 0, LVS CORRECT, distributed R+C+CC; 20 ohm series merge, 1 ohm shorts, 10 aF grounded coupling, every supply pin fed, kit via resistance unchanged
verification.waveforms: tests/spice/phased_waveforms.py two-pass contract: control ordering, settlement and pulse counts at the device-off level CONTROL_OFF = 0.2 VDD (1 % of on-current at FF 1.1 V 125 C), repeat edges with 0.05 VDD hysteresis; strict (0.1/0.9 VDD) verdict and metrics kept. Strict in both: unselected wordlines, W_EN/s_en exclusion, write-completion edges, retention, OUT/sense data, far-bitline restore within 0.05 VDD at the next admission (replica 0.95 VDD); cycle budgets use the 0.96 VDD restore crossing
verification.first_read: Decoder setup reserve 1.5x (settle before WL_EN) on overlap traces too
verification.solver: FineSim V-2023.12-SP1 spicexd, -mt 8, 20 ps maximum step, on the translated HSPICE deck (validated against HSPICE: docs/data/FINESIM_VALIDATION_V2_2_9.json); schematic DC operating point held as .IC
negative_controls: 32x256 with the 256x256 peripheral sizing at FF -40 C (unselected wordline glitch)
512x256 with a 22-stage enable-off guard at FF -40 C (ISO release before far W_EN off)
64x256 and 128x256 with row-class sizing at FF -40 C (ISO release 170 / 95 ps early)
